query: SELECT c.id, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents),0) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.id AND o.status='open') FROM customers c ORDER BY c.id
groupedQuery: SELECT c.id, COALESCE(t.total,0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id,SUM(total_cents) AS total FROM orders WHERE status='open' GROUP BY customer_id) t ON t.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY c.id
